# langsmith_evaluator (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith evaluator (LLM-as-judge or code).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_evaluator" "example" {
  workspace_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  name         = "tool call counts"
  type         = "code"

  code_evaluator = {
    language = "javascript"
    code     = <<-EOT
      function performEval(run) {
        const outputs = (run && run.outputs) || {}
        return { ok: outputs.error ? 0 : 1 }
      }
    EOT
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Evaluator name.
- `type` (String) Evaluator type: `llm` or `code`. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `code_evaluator` (Attributes) Code evaluator configuration. Required when `type = "code"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--code_evaluator))
- `delete_run_rules_on_destroy` (Boolean) When true, `terraform destroy` will cascade-delete any run rules that reference this evaluator. Defaults to false, in which case destroy fails with HTTP 409 if rules still exist.
- `llm_evaluator` (Attributes) LLM-as-judge configuration. Required when `type = "llm"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--llm_evaluator))
- `workspace_id` (String) LangSmith workspace (tenant) ID that owns this evaluator. When unset, the resource uses the workspace configured on the provider block.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `feedback_keys` (List of String) Feedback keys this evaluator emits, populated by the API.
- `id` (String) Evaluator ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--code_evaluator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `code_evaluator`

Required:

- `code` (String) Evaluator source code.

Optional:

- `language` (String) Source language: `python` (default) or `javascript`.


<a id="nestedatt--llm_evaluator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `llm_evaluator`

Optional:

- `commit_hash_or_tag` (String) Prompt commit hash or tag.
- `num_few_shot_examples` (Number) Number of few-shot examples to include from the corrections dataset.
- `prompt_repo_handle` (String) Prompt Hub repo handle (e.g. `owner/prompt`).
- `use_corrections_dataset` (Boolean) Whether the evaluator's run rules should write to a corrections dataset.
- `variable_mapping_json` (String) JSON-encoded `{prompt_var: run_field_path}` mapping.
